tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[Riemannian manifolds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0413, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0414 1. appG:G.8\group Length spaces For a connected Riemannian manifold $(\mathcal M^n,g)$, piecewise $C^1$ paths have length $\cL _g(\gamma )=\int |\dot\gamma |_g$, and $d(x,y)=\inf _\gamma \cL _g(\gamma )$. Completeness realizes this infimum by a geodesic, so $(\mathcal M,d)$ is a metric length space. \end{example}
